title: Fix hg38 default reference validation
description: Cluster launch with the new default genome resolves the hg38 iGenomes FASTA in the parameter summary but then fails validation saying a human FASTA is required. Trace validation ordering and make the default/reference parameter contract work on Rorqual.
acceptance_criteria: A launch with the default hg38 reference reaches workflow execution without a --fasta error; custom --fasta remains supported; the documented --skip-kraken2 spelling is accepted or documented correctly; regression coverage passes.
close_reason: Reopened after post-merge CLI recheck. The Nextflow 26 bare `--skip_kraken2` string is now accepted by schema and normalized in the Kraken workflow; default hg38 and custom FASTA previews plus all 6 CI-mode tests pass.

title: Route converted human-unmapped reads to contaminant classifiers
description: PR #1 review found HUMAN_READ_DEPLETION emits SAMTOOLS_FASTQ.out.other. Correct the output channel so Kraken2, Sylph, and Voyager receive the converted unmapped-read FASTQ, and add regression assertions that make an empty/wrong channel detectable.
acceptance_criteria: The depletion subworkflow emits the intended SAMtools FASTQ channel for single-end ONT data; focused classifier integration tests prove non-empty input reaches downstream profiling; all CI-mode tests pass.
close_reason: False positive from static review: single-end ONT records lack SAM READ1/READ2 flags and samtools fastq routes them via -0, which the maintained module exposes as out.other. The real Voyager run consumed 101 reads from test.unmapped_other.fastq.gz; no code change is required.

title: Default human reference to iGenomes hg38
description: Set the pipeline genome default to the configured iGenomes hg38 key, expose the same schema default, and document that an explicit FASTA remains an override.
acceptance_criteria: params.genome and schema default are hg38; default resolution follows the configured iGenomes path; docs describe the default and FASTA override; static validation passes.
close_reason: Set hg38 as default iGenomes reference, retained custom FASTA override, and validated configuration plus all 6 CI-mode nf-tests.
